question:
**Select the most appropriate meaning of the underlined idiom in the given sentence.**

That lady must __have an axe to grind__ that’s why she is not reporting your crime.
solution:
The correct answer is: **To have an ulterior motive **

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• "H**ave an axe to grind**" is an idiomatic phrase that means to have a private reason for doing or being involved in something. (किसी चीज को करने या उसमें शामिल होने का एक निजी कारण है)

 
 
• Example - *Environmentalists have no political axe to grind__, they just want to save the planet.*
 
 
 
• So, it is clear that the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom "**have an axe to grind**" is "**To have an ulterior motive**"

Hence, the correct answer is option 4.
